protocol.order: same process, alternate before/after and after/before each pair
protocol.timed: RetainedScene transaction commit, NativeRenderer::render_retained and submission.wait. Scene construction, compilation and image readback excluded.
protocol.pixels: Exact before/after readback equality for initial state, first and second mutations, and final state of every case.

scene.sparse_translation: one node per frame, translated 1/2 px alternately per 256-frame cycle
scene.dense_translation: all nodes translated 0/1 px every frame
scene.group_opacity: eight opacity groups, each with 32 leaves; one group changes 0.5/0.8 per frame
scene.sibling_reorder: first two siblings alternate move_before each frame, including order-key rebalance during sampling
scene.insert_remove: alternate insert/remove leaf 2000 before leaf 1000; 257 leaves on insertion frames
scene.reparent: 256 leaves initially alternate under two Group parents; leaf 1000 moves between them every frame
